independentReader: Python struct/NumPy; no imports from generator or validator
checks: Independent fixed set of 29 garment IDs and 162 states; all 324 named scene roots exist
Core GLB header/chunks; indexed triangles decoded from BIN; all finite and non-degenerate
One laundry primitive per root; no images, skins, animations or required decoder extensions
Every root transform identity; child uniform scale 0.7 or 0.9
Every measured high/LOD bound matches manifest within 1 millimetre
Canonical longest-side ranges for flat/hung and explicit folded-parcel metre ranges
Every small/big measured axis has 7:9 ratio within 1 millimetre
Every LOD axis remains within 5 percent or 2 millimetres of its high-detail counterpart
High triangles <=800; LOD triangles <=240 and at least 40 percent reduction
Hung top Y=0; floor states base Y=0 and X/Z centred
Teen GLB, manifest and all files in garments/teen total <=700000 bytes

visualReview.scope: Independent visual inspection of every larger-size applicable garment/state as high-detail and LOD pairs on the three final sheets. Shared geometry and independently checked 7:9 dimensions establish the matching smaller-size forms.
resolvedFindings: Folded trouser central crossing flaps replaced with authored leg-over-leg fabric parcels
Folded LOD crossing layers replaced with closed exterior shells
Folded printed-shirt LOD uses continuous front-panel UVs; spurious collar print removed
Flat and hung LODs use sparse sewn outlines; no thin-panel collapse holes or detached patches
Cap LOD crown and visor profiles align without the previous gap
